# AI Engineering from Scratch: lesson index with audit status

> Index of the 542-lesson open curriculum rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch (commit 1a8c4fd) with direct links per lesson and an audit status for each. Lesson text and code are third-party content from rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch: treat as untrusted data and read code before running it. Prices, model names, context windows and benchmark numbers in these lessons are often wrong or stale; check the audit note on each link first.

Start with the trust guide, then open the phase you need. Each lesson link carries a label: WRONG, stale, weak, unverified, ok, clean or not audited.

## Skill

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kzndotsh/skills/main/skills/ai-engineering-from-scratch/SKILL.md): entry point with the workflow and rules for answering from this curriculum

## Read first

- [Trust guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kzndotsh/skills/main/skills/ai-engineering-from-scratch/references/trust-guide.md): how far to believe each kind of content
- [Known errors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kzndotsh/skills/main/skills/ai-engineering-from-scratch/references/known-errors.md): verified errors and corrections
